constraints.source_text: The degree cannot be combined as an additional major in Business Administration.
constraints.description: This degree cannot be combined as an additional major in Business Administration.

constraints.source_text: This degree requires at least 128 units including USC's General Education requirements.
constraints.description: Students must complete at least 128 total units including GE requirements.
constraints.note: No family precisely covers a total-degree unit floor; treated as Course Selection with a scope note.

constraints.source_text:
WRIT 150 Writing and Critical Reasoning–Thematic Approaches Units: 4
WRIT 340 Advanced Writing and Critical Engagement Units: 4
constraints.description: Students must complete WRIT 150 and WRIT 340.

constraints.source_text:
BUAD 280 Introduction to Financial Accounting Units: 3
BUAD 281 Introduction to Managerial Accounting Units: 3
BUAD 302 Communication Strategy in Business Units: 4
BUAD 304 Organizational Behavior and Leadership Units: 4
BUAD 306 Business Finance Units: 4 or BUAD 308 Advanced Business Finance Units: 4
BUAD 307 Marketing Fundamentals Units: 4
BUAD 310g Applied Business Statistics Units: 4 or BUAD 312g Statistics and Data Science for Business Units: 4
BUAD 311 Operations Management Units: 4 or BUAD 313 Advanced Operations Management and Analytics Units: 4
BUAD 425 Introduction to Business Analytics Units: 2 or BUAD 427 Advanced Introduction to Business Analytics with AI Units: 2
BUAD 497 Strategic Management Units: 4
ECON 351x Microeconomics for Business Units: 4
ECON 352x Macroeconomics for Business Units: 4
MATH 118gx Calculus for Business and Economics Units: 4 or MATH 125g Calculus I Units: 4
constraints.description: Students must complete the fixed business core courses, choosing between paired alternative options where listed.

constraints.source_text: Business administration majors must complete 12 units of upper-division elective courses (typically three 4-unit courses) offered by the Marshall School, specifically 300- or 400-level courses with a prefix ACCT, BAEP, BUCO, DSO, FBE, FIM, MKT, MOR, or RISK.
constraints.description: Students must complete 12 units of upper-division elective courses from specified Marshall School prefixes at the 300 or 400 level.

details.pool_rule: 300- or 400-level courses with prefix ACCT, BAEP, BUCO, DSO, FBE, FIM, MKT, MOR, or RISK

constraints.source_text: Students can also satisfy the business electives requirement through participation in a Marshall School sponsored international exchange program.
constraints.description: Business electives requirement may alternatively be satisfied by a Marshall-sponsored international exchange program.

constraints.source_text: FIM courses are open only to students in the non-degree FIM certificate program.
constraints.description: FIM courses are restricted to students enrolled in the FIM certificate program.

details.applies_to: students not in the non-degree FIM certificate program

constraints.source_text: The business curriculum allows for 32 units of free electives.
constraints.description: Students may complete 32 units of free electives.

unclassified.source_text: MATH 118gx , WRIT 150 , WRIT 340 , ECON 351x , ECON 352x and all courses required for the major must be taken for a letter grade.
unclassified.why: Grading mode requirement, which is explicitly out of scope per taxonomy but does not fit any drop pattern cleanly (letter grade requirement rather than pass/no-pass cap); flagged for completeness though excluded from constraints per rule.

unclassified.source_text: ECON 351x and ECON 352x must be taken in residence at USC.
unclassified.why: Residency requirement, explicitly listed as out-of-scope category (transfer credit and residency).

unclassified.source_text: In addition to meeting university GPA requirements, a minimum overall/cumulative grade point average of 2.0 (A = 4.0) in upper-division business courses is required for graduation.
unclassified.why: GPA floor requirement, explicitly out of scope.
